title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic ships Claude Sonnet 5 as the new default — "most agentic Sonnet yet"
bullets.summary: Sonnet 5 is now the default on Free/Pro, built to plan and drive tools (browsers, terminals) autonomously, at intro pricing of $2/M in and $10/M out through Aug 31.
bullets.how: A direct routing-layer input: bench Sonnet 5 against Opus 4.8 / OpenAI Sol / Grok 4.5 for Construct coding + computer-use jobs, but keep provider-agnostic routing so adoption is a config change, not a rebuild.

bullets.title: Anthropic expands Cowork to mobile and web — sessions and files follow you across devices
bullets.summary: Cowork now spans mobile + web with background work, scheduled tasks, shared chat/projects, and mobile approvals (beta starting with Max).
bullets.how: This is the platform The Construct runs on; cross-device sessions + mobile approvals mean scans survive Cowork closing on desktop and Bobby can approve write-actions from the iPhone. Pressure-test our scheduled tasks against the new background/mobile execution model.

bullets.title: Claude Code makes Claude-in-Chrome GA and adds a /dataviz skill + draft-PR handoff
bullets.summary: Claude in Chrome ships GA with background notifications, draft-PR handoff, improved failover, better session handling, and a new /dataviz skill for chart/dashboard design.
bullets.how: Browser-agent GA maps to Brand 9 Signs web + kiosk/signage front-end QA and Pulse owned-presence automation; /dataviz assists the V4 dashboard panels; improved failover/session handling targets our exact failure mode (scans dying when a session closes).

bullets.title: Press Ranger launches the first MCP server for press-release distribution
bullets.summary: The V1 server (Jul 9) connects Claude/ChatGPT/Codex to Press Ranger, turning a plain-language announcement into an on-brand release written into the account.
bullets.how: Pairs with yesterday's Featured (PR-agency) MCP to complete an earned-media stack — find query/journalist via Featured, draft + distribute via Press Ranger. Maps to B9/PRAGMA's owned-presence + earned-media wedge; wrap both behind Pulse for end-to-end client PR ops.

bullets.title: arXiv review: "Externalization in LLM Agents — Memory, Skills, Protocols and Harness Engineering"
bullets.summary: A unified review framing agent capability as externalized layers (memory, skills, MCP-style protocols, code harness) rather than in-weights ability.
bullets.how: A recent (not this-week) framework, but the cleanest map for our new-skills scan and installed-skills registry: treat skills, memory, and MCP connectors as governed, versioned external assets and instrument each layer separately.

praxis_lesson: Anthropic spent this cycle deepening the two layers The Construct stands on — the default agent model (Sonnet 5) and the substrate it runs in (Cowork on mobile/web, Claude-in-Chrome GA, better failover) — while the earned-media MCP stack filled in beneath us (Featured + now Press Ranger). Ride the platform improvements directly (cross-device execution, browser QA, /dataviz) instead of rebuilding them, and keep concentrating original work where we own it: provider-agnostic model routing and owned MCP orchestration that wraps vertical MCPs like Featured and Press Ranger behind Pulse into one client PR/owned-presence operator.
